title: Spliced and unspliced layers
methods:
**Data and cells.** The cohort's 10x datasets, each run from its FASTQs on its own 2024-A reference (see gex-counts). Cells are the barcodes STARsolo EmptyDrops_CR calls; a comparison uses the cells all three tools have and their shared genes.

**Layers.** Singlet: unspliced = intron_counts, spliced + ambiguous = exon_counts (spliced = exon_counts - ambiguous_counts). STARsolo Velocyto: unspliced, and spliced + ambiguous. alevin-fry USA: U, and S + A.

**Why spliced+ambiguous.** STARsolo labels a molecule against individual transcripts, so exonic reads compatible with an intron-retaining isoform become ambiguous; Singlet uses the collapsed gene model and calls them spliced; alevin-fry calls ambiguous every read compatible with both targets. Unspliced means the same in all three, and spliced + ambiguous is the rest of the molecules, so those two layers are gated. The ambiguous share of each tool is reported.

**Measures, for every pair of tools.** The distance of the median per-cell UMI ratio from 1 (|ln ratio|); the median over cells of the Pearson r of log1p counts over genes; the Spearman rho of pseudobulk gene counts.

**Gate.** Singlet's mean value against the two competitors (STARsolo Velocyto and alevin-fry USA) must be as good as the competitors' value against each other, within the half-width of the paired bootstrap 95% CI of the difference: Singlet is gated as a member of the cloud of existing tools. Per-reference values are in each metric's notes. All settings were fixed before the metrics were computed.

tools.name: singlet
tools.params: singlet encode --reads R1.fastq.gz R2.fastq.gz -o s.1fq; singlet s.1fq --ref-base $REF --genome-dir $REF/$SPECIES/star_2.7.11b --exons $REF/$SPECIES/genes/genes.gtf --out-prefix $OUT/ --threads 8 --pipeline --output-format mtx --raw-matrix  (spliced = exon_counts - ambiguous_counts, unspliced = intron_counts)

tools.name: starsolo-velocyto
tools.citation: La Manno et al. RNA velocity of single cells. Nature 2018 (velocyto rules); Kaminow et al. bioRxiv 2021 (STARsolo)
tools.params: STAR --runThreadN 16 --genomeDir $GENOME --readFilesIn $R2 $R1 --readFilesCommand zcat --soloType CB_UMI_Simple --soloCBwhitelist $WHITELIST --soloCBlen 16 --soloUMIstart 17 --soloUMIlen $UMILEN --soloBarcodeReadLength 0 --soloStrand $STRAND --soloFeatures Gene GeneFull Velocyto SJ --soloCellFilter EmptyDrops_CR --soloCBmatchWLtype 1MM_multi_Nbase_pseudocounts --soloUMIfiltering MultiGeneUMI_CR --soloUMIdedup 1MM_CR --clipAdapterType CellRanger4 --outFilterScoreMin 30 --outSAMtype None (Velocyto layers: spliced, unspliced, ambiguous)

tools.name: alevin-fry-usa
tools.params: simpleaf quant --reads1 $R1 --reads2 $R2 --index af_idx/index --t2g-map af_idx/index/t2g_3col.tsv --chemistry $CHEM --expected-ori fw --resolution cr-like --unfiltered-pl $WHITELIST --threads 16 (USA matrix: S, U, A blocks)

metrics.name: Per-cell UMI total, distance of the median ratio from 1, unspliced UMI

rule.rationale: gate = Singlet's mean |ln ratio| distance to STARsolo Velocyto unspliced, alevin-fry USA unspliced against the distance the competitors have from each other (0.0163); tolerance = half-width of the paired bootstrap 95% CI of the difference: 0.0018

metrics.notes: Singlet vs each competitor (S/competitor for ratios): STARsolo Velocyto unspliced: ratio 0.972; alevin-fry USA unspliced: ratio 0.985. Basis: cells with UMI in every tool (1229). Competitor value = its mean distance to the other competitors.

figures.title: Ambiguous share of molecules
figures.caption: Pooled over the common cells. The spliced / ambiguous line is drawn differently by each tool.

caveats: Spliced-only and ambiguous-only layers are not gated: the three tools define the spliced / ambiguous boundary differently, so agreement there would measure definitions, not accuracy.
There is no ground truth for velocity layers; agreement between STARsolo and alevin-fry sets the tolerance, so a metric where the two competitors happen to agree closely is a strict test.
Singlet's collapsed gene model reports far fewer ambiguous molecules than STARsolo and alevin-fry; RNA velocity users who use only the spliced layer will see a different spliced / unspliced ratio.
The 5' dataset is the first 60 M read pairs; alevin-fry used expected orientation fw (simpleaf's own default for 10xv2-5p).
Wall time and memory in resources are from a shared cluster at differing thread counts and are not a speed comparison.
Cohort datasets assigned to spliced-unspliced that this document does not cover (no run for them in this benchmark yet): pbmc5k_v4_d1, mouse_brain_nuclei5k_v31.
conclusion: On 7 datasets Singlet's unspliced UMI per cell is 0.96-1.10 of STARsolo Velocyto's and 0.91-1.05 of alevin-fry USA's (median ratio), and its spliced+ambiguous UMI 1.04-1.32 of STARsolo's; 18 of 42 gating metrics pass (Singlet inside the spread of the two competitors). Spliced and ambiguous alone are defined differently by each tool (ambiguous share: Singlet 0.2%-4.4%, STARsolo 6.5%-10.2%, alevin-fry 32.1%-60.2%) and are not gated.
